regime.platform: National unified e-invoice service platform (全国统一电子发票服务平台)
regime.label: China - fully digitalised e-invoices (数电票)
regime.identifier_label: 20-digit invoice number assigned by the platform
regime.correction_mechanism: red-letter invoice (红字数电票) issued against a red-letter confirmation (红字发票信息确认单); a confirmation not accepted within 72 hours lapses
regime.scope: Every taxpayer, nationwide, since 2024-12-01. Construction services carry the special-business tag 建筑服务 with the site location and the project name.

commencement.scope: All taxpayers nationwide, fully digitalised e-invoices through the national platform
commencement.notes: STA Announcement 2024 No.11: Art.3 face fields, Art.4 the 20-digit number (two-digit year, two-digit provincial bureau, one channel digit, 15-digit serial), Art.2 special-business tags, Art.8 red-letter confirmation.

regime.notes: The platform prepares the invoice data and does not transmit it: no adapter is registered for this country. Issuing a 数电票 needs the taxpayer's own access to the national platform or a certified channel, which is a per-company integration. The prepared data (JSON or XML) is imported there, and the issued 20-digit number, PDF and OFD are recorded back on the invoice and validated.
